description: Frank Russo contacts the adult continuing education intake coordinator (referred by Mark Thompson, auto shop teacher) to request a meeting about offering an AV literacy curriculum through the district adult ed program. He arrives with a two-page three-module outline: Riding Safe, The Override Moment, and Sharing the Road. This is not a cold call — it comes with a warm referral from an existing district faculty member. No money changes hands this tick. This is a relationship-and-pipeline transaction: Frank is converting two ticks of relationship-building with Mark Thompson into a formal first contact with the institution he wants to teach for.
notes: If meeting is scheduled, Frank has the curriculum asset ready to present. This transaction also signals to the simulation that Frank is now an active participant in the retraining ecosystem, not a passive observer. He is building toward potential future income through adult ed instruction fees or per-course stipends.
